My name is [Thomas Scherer](http://localhost:6356/www.tlscherer.com). I have worked in government at the US Institute of Peace, academia at the University of California, San Diego, non-profits at the think tank fp21, and media at Bloomberg Economics. I am a volunteer firefighter, gamer, and husky dad. I earned a PhD in international relations from Princeton University.

I am the author of [AbroadReview](www.abroadreview.com), a living literature review on topics in foreign policy and international relations (also available on [Beehiiv](https://abroadreview.beehiiv.com/) and [Substack](https://abroadreview.substack.com/)). It's goal is to provide a clear perspective on world events based on theories and evidence from international relations academic research.

AI usage: No AI is used in any writing on this website, just Grammarly. I have used Gemini to assist with coding in Quarto and R for creating the website.

#### About the website

This website is built on Quarto and hosted on Github. It was widely adapted from a template by [Dr. Gang He](http://drganghe.github.io/).
